senses.gloss:
√ukṣ [252] or vakṣ (ukṣáti, -te; aúkṣīt;
ukṣiṣyáti; ukṣitá; -úkṣya). sprinkle;
besprinkle; drop, intrans., 75^7. [secondary
form (108g end) of √*uj or ug: cf. ὑγ-ρός,
‘wet’; Lat. ūvens (*ugvens) caelum, ‘the
dropping sky’; w. ukṣán, ‘besprinkler,
impregnator, bull,’ cf. Goth. auhsa, ‘bull,’
Eng. ox, and for mg, √vṛṣ.]
+ pra, sprinkle before one by way of
consecration.
